verifications.claim: Trump Accounts are tax-advantaged investment accounts for U.S. citizen children under 18.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R6: 'tax-advantaged investment accounts for U.S. citizens under the age of 18'; R1: 'any child with a Social Security number who is age 17 or younger'; R2: 'Children under 18 with a Social Security number are eligible'; R7: 'child who has not turned age 18... valid Social Security number' (no citizen req for account)
verifications.reasoning: Some sources explicitly limit to U.S. citizens (R6), others state eligibility as under 18 with SSN only (R1,R2,R7), contradicting citizen requirement.

verifications.claim: Trump Accounts were established by the 2025 "One Big Beautiful Bill Act."
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'One Big Beautiful Bill Act passed in July 2025'; R2: 'One Big Beautiful Bill Act created'; R3: 'Trump’s One, Big, Beautiful Bill Act, which was signed into law on July 4'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources directly confirm establishment by the 2025 One Big Beautiful Bill Act.

verifications.evidence: R6: 'Launching July 4, 2026'; R8: 'available for initial deposits on July 4, 2026'; R3: 'launches July 5'; R4: 'go live until July 5, 2026'; R5: 'start taking contributions beginning July 5, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict on exact date: some specify July 4 (R6,R8,R9), others July 5 (R3,R4,R5).

verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm the $1,000 government seed as a key feature for eligible children.

verifications.claim: Trump Accounts are for children born between 2025–2028.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'any child... age 17 or younger'; R2: 'Children under 18 with a Social Security number'; R3: 'for children under 18' (seed only for 2025-2028)
verifications.reasoning: All sources state accounts eligible for children under 18 (with SSN), not limited to birth years 2025-2028 (which is only for seed).

verifications.claim: Parents, family, or employers can contribute up to $5,000 annually per child to Trump Accounts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'parents and others... up to $5,000 annually'; R2: 'annual contributions up to $5,000 from multiple sources including family members... employers'; R3: 'up to $5,000 per year... from employers every year'
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported: total annual limit $5,000 from parents, family, employers, etc.

verifications.claim: Trump Accounts receive a one-time $1,000 deposit from the Treasury.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'give eligible American children born between... a one-time deposit of $1,000'; R2: 'one-time $1,000 seed contribution for certain children born between 2025–2028'
verifications.reasoning: Supported but only for specific eligible children (born 2025-2028 citizens), not all Trump Accounts.

verifications.claim: The one-time $1,000 Treasury deposit for Trump Accounts is for children born January 1, 2025 – December 31, 2028.
verifications.label: CLEAR
